# FLIPO

> FLIPO (flipoteam.com) is a Singapore-based brand licensing and co-branding market-intelligence company. It surveys audiences visually, profiles fans, and connects licensors, licensees and retailers. It acts as a "super-connector" in the licensing industry: customer-centric partnerships, driven by data, not intuition.

## What FLIPO does

- Market Intelligence: measures an audience's preferences across fandoms, products and any element within an intellectual property universe. No guesswork, just objective, winning insights.
- The Super-Connector: transforms data into partnerships, functioning as the single access point to the global brand ecosystem and streamlining the industry into one seamless workflow.
- Integration model: Tech (proprietary visual surveying technology) and Network (industry relationships) work as one connected loop.

## Methodology

- Capturing Emotions: surveys are purely visual, to capture instinctive preferences in the language consumers already understand.
- Audience Profiling: audiences are hyper-profiled by exposing them to visual stimuli, enabling deep categorization based on levels of resonance.
- Data Experts: statistical modeling turns a sample's response into a population's truth; a few thousand voices reveal what millions think.
- Respondents come from research panels (a pool of over 300 million respondents), accessed through FLIPO's API.

## What to expect

- 130+ countries unlocked
- Audiences from 3 years old and above
- Results in under 2 weeks
- 50% lower marketing cost
- 2x more new customers
- Boosted brand credibility

## Who FLIPO helps

- Licensors: understand your audience across markets.
- Licensees: invest in the trends that drive behaviour.
- Retailers: commercialize products and experiences that resonate.
- Creative studios: validate new original content.
- Investors: value intellectual properties.
- Industry experts: convince with market signals.
- Marketers: target consumers with confidence.
- Sales teams: find the data points that drive conversion.

## How it works

1. Hop on an alignment call: no obligations, just a conversation about your journey, audience and ambitions.
2. Separate the signal from the noise: FLIPO finds and surveys your ideal customers at scale.
3. Wait for the partnership to come to you: FLIPO's network spans the co-branding ecosystem and bridges partnerships.

Compared with a full-time hire ($10-15k/month), a generalist market-intelligence firm ($15-50k per study, months to deliver) or an agency (5k/month retainers), FLIPO works as an extension of your team at a fraction of the cost.

## Team

- Nico, Founder: close to a decade of corporate experience building and managing licensing programs, including the expansion of multi-million dollar franchises such as Transformers, My Little Pony and Power Rangers, and helping a startup grow annual revenue from $2M to over $30M through strategic partnering.
- Riko, Head of Tech; Muhammad, Head of Data; Helena, Chief Editor; Beltran, Survey Designer.

## FAQ

- What services do you offer? Market intelligence and networking referrals, bridging optimal partners within the co-branding industry.
- How do we ensure our interests are aligned with yours? The referral framework is built upon a revenue-success model.
- Do you represent any intellectual properties? No. Independence from IP representation guarantees honest and unbiased insights.
- How do you access respondents? Research panels enable access to a pre-recruited pool of respondents.
- Tell me more about your technology? Patented technology recreates purchasing scenarios through images.
- What is brand licensing? A model in which two entities, a content expert and an industry expert, empower each other to co-create products and experiences that serve market segments.
- How do you work with panels? An application programming interface lets FLIPO leverage any selected panel while maintaining control over the respondents' journey.
- Is artificial intelligence involved when surveying? No.
